decision.explanation: The question asks when Arteaga (footballer) began his professional career. The most specific and directly supported answer is "1 October 2016," which is explicitly stated in D1S5: "On 1 October 2016 Arteaga made his professional debut in the Liga MX against Querétaro F.C." This is a direct match for the requested relation and provides the precise date. Other candidates like "2016" are less granular and not independently sufficient. The other candidates (15/8/2010 and 1990-91 season) refer to different individuals named Arteaga (Venezuelan and Mexican, respectively), not the subject of the question.
